metadata.description: PDCA-native Knowledge Work OS with Cross-Plugin Orchestrator — 15 skills, 18 commands, 17 Pokemon agents, 31 MCP tools. Settles a fork into a decision standard your project keeps, checks artifacts against those standards, and bars whoever helped make something from passing it. Artifact Viewer, cycle memory, code engineering lane, and a zero-key adaptive fetch chain for hostile URLs.
